name: coding-to-production
summary: Coding agents prepare changes on GitHub; people review merges and release deployments inside change windows (G0 M8 C4).
protects: every merge into a named repository waits for an independent code reviewer, bound to the head SHA
every deployment of a named repository waits for a release approver inside a change window
no branch creation or contents write on a named repository's default branch
the agent does not merge or push from the shell (a heuristic over the command text)
the agent's grant covers the GitHub operations on the named repositories only, with one merge per run
excludes: renaming a default branch: apply the template again
people: bind code_reviewer and release_approver yourself (pclaw role bind)
routes in monitor mode record the rules' decisions and do not block

connections: a pc.github connection in enforce mode for the repositories
the pclaw shell hook (pclaw init) for the shell rule
